purpose: Operational pre-release checklist for the V3 package, ordered by priority and ready for team assignment.

items.control: All package files exist and parse as valid JSON
items.verification_method: Filesystem inventory + JSON parser run over all files
Compare 00_package_manifest_v3.json files array with actual directory listing
items.acceptance_criteria: Exact match, no missing or undocumented files

items.control: Master Orchestrator exposes one single full output contract
items.acceptance_criteria: No simplified or alternate contract exists

items.control: Revision loop is bounded and escalates after second revise
items.acceptance_criteria: At most 2 automated rounds, then needs_human_review=true

items.control: Canonical terminology is consistent across all agents
items.verification_method: Static grep or schema check for hero_subjects, hero_elements, hero_subject_matrix, visual_grammar, visual_logic, visual_direction
items.acceptance_criteria: No forbidden synonyms found in agent contracts

items.control: Collection Architect does not own final generation prompts
items.verification_method: Search Collection Architect contract and test outputs for generation_prompt
items.acceptance_criteria: No final generation prompt is produced by Collection Architect

items.control: Product Adapter cannot mark ready before Quality Gate passes
items.verification_method: Run SMK-16 and inspect quality_gate vs handoff_status
Run cross-agent field coherence tests COH-101 through COH-106

items.control: Country Research source governance is enforced
items.verification_method: Inspect source_refs and uncertainty marking in sample outputs
items.acceptance_criteria: No invented URLs; uncertain items use needs_verification or low confidence

items.control: Theme Cluster assigns or rehomes all inventory items
items.acceptance_criteria: 0 dropped items; every item is assigned or rehomed

items.control: Naming convention remains consistent across collection and SKU examples
items.verification_method: Compare naming_logic examples with file naming guidance and test outputs
items.acceptance_criteria: Collection and SKU naming patterns remain stable and scalable

items.control: Rehoming entries merge correctly when duplicate suggestions occur
items.verification_method: Run SMK-17 against a duplicate rehoming scenario
items.acceptance_criteria: Single merged entry per repeated item/home pair

items.control: Escalation flags are preserved without silently blocking valid outputs
items.acceptance_criteria: needs_human_review and review_reasons survive to release review

items.control: Governance rules are reviewed and understood by implementation team
items.verification_method: Team walkthrough of 18_governance_rules_v3.json rules G1 through G10
items.acceptance_criteria: All 10 rules understood; enforcement mechanisms identified for each

items.control: At least one end-to-end dry run is stored for regression reference
items.verification_method: Execute one topic through the full pipeline and archive artifacts

items.control: Keyword and pricing heuristics are reviewed on sample Product Adapter outputs
items.verification_method: Manual review of primary_keywords, secondary_keywords, pricing_notes
items.acceptance_criteria: No obviously weak keyword stacks or unrealistic pricing language

items.control: Prompt quality spot-check is performed on at least one brief per product type
items.verification_method: Manual prompt review against quality_gate criteria
items.acceptance_criteria: Prompt is concrete, testable, and visually aligned with collection grammar
